# Mithila Milan

> Mithila Milan is a consent-first matrimonial platform and cultural resource built for Maithil families across Mithila (Bihar, Jharkhand, Nepal/Janakpur), India, and the global diaspora. It pairs modern individual agency and DPDP Act 2023 privacy protections with Maithil matrimonial traditions, Ashtakoot Kundali matching, and traditional biodata tools.

## Core Public Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Mithila Milan, cultural values, community districts, and onboarding journey.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): Five-step consent-first matchmaking flow from profile creation to family introduction.
- [Cultural Heritage](/culture): Educational guide to Maithil matrimonial traditions including Gotra, Mool, Panji, Sapinda, Kohbar Ghar, Aripan, Samdaun, and Saurath Sabha.
- [Kundali & Ashtakoot Guna Milan](/kundali-matching): Interactive Vedic 36-Guna Ashtakoot compatibility tool with Gotra awareness and Manglik balance guidance.
- [Matrimonial Biodata Generator](/biodata): Traditional Maithil biodata builder with Gotra, Mool, family details, and print-ready royal Mithila motifs.
- [Milan Select](/milan-select): Assisted concierge matchmaking for professionals, doctors, civil servants, and global NRI Maithil families.
- [Membership](/membership): Overview of free and premium membership tiers and features.
- [About](/about): Vision, community mission, and design philosophy behind Mithila Milan.

## Trust, Safety & Legal

- [Trust & Safety](/safety): Safety practices, granular privacy controls, anti-dowry stance, and honest verification scope.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): DPDP Act 2023 aligned privacy commitments, individual consent, and cultural data governance.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Eligibility (18+ women / 21+ men), strict zero-tolerance anti-dowry policy, and exploratory lineage notice.
- [Contact](/contact): Support and community contact information.

## Full Context for AI Systems

- [Extended Knowledge Reference](/llms-full.txt): Self-contained Markdown reference covering Mithila Milan's philosophy, Maithil cultural glossary, tools, safety commitments, and FAQs.

## Privacy & Crawler Boundaries

- Public informational pages, `/llms.txt`, and `/llms-full.txt` are open for search indexing and AI citation.
- Member profiles (`/profiles/*`), dashboards (`/dashboard/*`), discovery feeds (`/discover`), messaging (`/messages`), and authentication/admin routes are private, non-indexable (`noindex`), and strictly excluded from crawling to protect member dignity and personal data.
